name: federation
description: Manage GraphQL Federation: compose an Apollo Router supergraph from installed plugin subgraphs, check subgraph health, and introspect the composed schema.
author: nself

actions.compose: Re-compose the supergraph schema from installed plugin subgraphs
actions.status: Show subgraph health and schema composition state
actions.introspect: Print the full supergraph schema to stdout

notes: This is a CLI-proxy plugin, not a service plugin: it has no port, no HTTP server, and no database tables of its own. `nself plugin install federation` must place the built nself-federation binary at ~/.nself/plugins/bin/nself-federation, where internal/plugin/router.go's ProxyCommand execs it for `nself federation <args>` with stdio inherited. Extracted from cli/cmd/commands/federation.go under CLI-R11. Federation is opt-in (NSELF_FEDERATION=true) and not license-gated, so this is a free plugin.
